item.description: One person is dead following a rollover crash involving a semi-truck on Friday in the West Valley.The crash happened on Feb. 20 in the eastbound lanes of Interstate 10 at Palo Verde Road.The Arizona Department of Public Safety says a car crossed all lanes of traffic and crashed into a semi-truck, causing the semi to roll over. item.description: A longtime West Valley restaurant owner detained by ICE since May 2025 has just been released from custody.Kelly Yu's story has drawn national attention, with community members and lawmakers trying to help her.
